properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Not presence-only: this is the app's live signing path. @noble/curves@1.2.0 is a transitive dep of viem ^1.20.0 (direct dep of packages/force-inclusion) and of @scure/bip32 (via hardhat@2.22.18 → @metamask/eth-sig-util). packages/force-inclusion/scripts/force-inclusion-test.js:97-112 signs the Orbit rollup deployment through viem/accounts privateKeyToAccount/generatePrivateKey, which reach @noble/curves secp256k1. Changeable here (dependency pin). Library facet: LIB-e9aa10c7 (other shard).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 is part of @noble/curves@1.2.0's shipped surface (transitive via viem ^1.20.0, packages/force-inclusion, and the hardhat→@metamask/eth-sig-util→@scure chain). No Ed25519 call site in the application — the app only exercises the secp256k1 member (ALG-92b28f71). Available in the shipped library; that is the inventory fact. Quantum-unsafe under Shor, deadline-class risk.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This is the app-wide live signature path, not presence-only: ethers ^5.7.2 is a direct dependency, and every tutorial script instantiates `new Wallet(process.env.PRIVATE_KEY, provider)` and signs contract deployments/transactions (e.g. packages/token-withdraw/scripts/exec.js:16,21-22,34; packages/force-inclusion/scripts/force-inclusion-test.js:221). Ethereum account security rests entirely on ECDSA secp256k1. Library facet: LIB-a0bfbc1a. Changeable only ecosystem-wide (Ethereum L1 signature sche

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@1.0.3 ships X25519 (crypto_scalarmult) as part of its NaCl surface; it reaches the build via hardhat@2.22.18 → @metamask/eth-sig-util@4.0.1. No application call site found — hardhat pulls it for typed-data (EIP-712) signing support. Available in the shipped library; no call site found in the application. Library facet: LIB-0469707e (other shard).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@3.1.2 is the PBKDF2 implementation behind @ethersproject/pbkdf2 (ethers ^5.7.2), used for encrypted-JSON-keystore (kdf) decryption. The tutorials load raw keys from env instead, so no keystore path is exercised in the app; the primitive ships with the build. PBKDF2 is a KDF, not Shor-vulnerable (quantum-safe per catalogue). Library facet: LIB-ea49d4c1.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto library shipped in the build: @noble/hashes 1.2.0, transitive via @scure/bip32@1.1.5 / @scure/bip39@1.1.1 (← hardhat@2.22.18 → @metamask/eth-sig-util@4.0.1); viem ^1.20.0 pulls the 1.3.x line separately.
